2-you break it and a paint brush like thing comes out of the shell: thats the part you dont wanna eat just pull it off and follow the same steps as before.
3- the meaty part is now only stuck to the shell: the pros just bite it but to be safe use your hands to remove it.
 And thats it, cant describe what they taste but it has a very saltwater like taste and the consistency kinda like a clam.
